name: bridges-e2e-tests
description: E2E tests for Gnosis Chain bridges (xDAI bridge & Omnibridge)

scripts.setup:docker-oracle: docker compose -f src/setup/docker/docker-compose-amb.yml up -d && docker compose -f src/setup/docker/docker-compose-xdai.yml up -d
scripts.test:multicall: npm run test:multicall:usds-to-gc && npm run test:multicall:xdai-to-usds && npm run test:multicall:gno-eth-to-gc && npm run test:multicall:gno-gc-to-eth && npm run test:multicall:mixed-eth-to-gc && npm run test:multicall:mixed-gc-to-eth
scripts.test:xdai: npm run test:xdai:usds-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:dai-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-usds && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-dai
scripts.test:omni: npm run test:omni:eth-to-weth && npm run test:omni:weth-to-eth && npm run test:omni:gno-eth-to-gc && npm run test:omni:gno-gc-to-eth
scripts.test: npm run test:xdai && npm run test:omni && npm run test:multicall
scripts.test:xdai:autoclaim: npm run test:xdai:usds-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:dai-to-gc && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-usds:autoclaim && npm run test:xdai:xdai-to-dai:autoclaim
scripts.test:omni:autoclaim: npm run test:omni:eth-to-weth && npm run test:omni:weth-to-eth:autoclaim && npm run test:omni:gno-eth-to-gc && npm run test:omni:gno-gc-to-eth:autoclaim
scripts.test:multicall:autoclaim: npm run test:multicall:usds-to-gc && npm run test:multicall:xdai-to-usds:autoclaim && npm run test:multicall:gno-eth-to-gc && npm run test:multicall:gno-gc-to-eth:autoclaim && npm run test:multicall:mixed-eth-to-gc && npm run test:multicall:mixed-gc-to-eth:autoclaim
scripts.test:autoclaim: npm run test:xdai:autoclaim && npm run test:omni:autoclaim && npm run test:multicall:autoclaim
